title: The Impact of Trade Payment Restrictions and Capital Controls on External Sector Balances
title_zh: 贸易支付限制与资本管制对外部部门收支平衡的影响
title_primary: 贸易支付限制与资本管制对外部部门收支平衡的影响
title_secondary: The Impact of Trade Payment Restrictions and Capital Controls on External Sector Balances
authors: Adam Jakubik & Effie Karfaki & Tobias Krahnke & Wenjie Li & Ms. Anita Tuladhar & Chenyu Xu
official: 官方在线 2026-09-04 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Models of external balances rely on economic fundamentals, structural indicators, cyclical variables, and policy factors. However, existing models may not fully capture the effects of restrictions on trade payments and capital controls. In this paper, we include two new policy variables in a standard empirical model of the current account to address this gap: the Measure of Aggregate Trade Restrictions (MATR) and the FinOpen index. The results indicate that tighter restrictions on trade payments of one standard deviation are associated with increases in the current account balance of about one percentage point and an appreciation of the real effective exchange rate (REER). These effects primarily operate through suppressing import demand and reducing domestic absorption. Tightening capital inflow restrictions by one standard deviation increases the current account balance by about 1.4 percentage points and depreciates the REER. Outflow restrictions operate in the opposite direction. These effects are primarily due to a wedge between domestic and global real interest rates, which in turn affect saving and investment decisions. Updating these models to assess how trade payment and capital controls affect current account balances helps support more actionable policy recommendations.
abstract_zh: 外部平衡模型依赖于经济基本面、结构性指标、周期性变量及政策因素。然而，现有模型可能未能充分捕捉贸易支付限制与资本管制的影响。为弥补这一缺口，本文在标准经常账户实证模型中引入了两个新的政策变量：总体贸易限制度量（MATR）与金融开放指数（FinOpen）。研究结果显示，贸易支付限制收紧一个标准差，与经常账户余额增加约一个百分点及实际有效汇率（REER）升值相关联。这些效应主要通过抑制进口需求和减少国内吸收发挥作用。资本流入限制收紧一个标准差，会使经常账户余额增加约1.4个百分点，并导致实际有效汇率贬值。而资本流出限制则产生相反效应。这些影响主要源于国内与国际实际利率之间的差异，进而影响储蓄与投资决策。更新这些模型以评估贸易支付与资本管制如何影响经常账户余额，有助于提出更具操作性的政策建议。

title: Monitoring decreases discrimination
title_zh: 监督减少歧视
title_primary: 监督减少歧视
title_secondary: Monitoring decreases discrimination
authors: Edmund Baker, Veronika Grimm, Yuval Ofek‐Shanny
official: 官方在线 2026-09-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study whether awareness of monitoring or study participation affects racial discrimination. Online participants rated résumés signaling either a Black or White candidate under Control, Monitoring, and Experiment conditions. Across conditions, we unexpectedly find a small average preference for Black résumés, possibly reflecting temporarily heightened racial awareness. The Control condition exhibits greater racial bias in both directions. This pattern suggests that monitoring and awareness of being studied can suppress discriminatory behavior. The findings underscore the importance of credible cover stories in discrimination experiments and indicate that subtle accountability cues may reduce bias in evaluative settings such as hiring.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了监控意识或研究参与是否会影响种族歧视。在线参与者在控制、监控和实验条件下，对表明黑人候选人或白人候选人的简历进行评分。在各条件下，我们意外发现对黑人简历存在轻微的平均偏好，这可能反映了暂时增强的种族意识。控制条件在双向均表现出更大的种族偏见。这一模式表明，监控及被研究的意识可能抑制歧视行为。研究结果强调了在歧视实验中可信掩护故事的重要性，并指出微妙的问责提示可能减少招聘等评估环境中的偏见。

title: When Microenterprises Grow, Are Consumers Better Off? Evidence from Large Loans to Microenterprises in Chile
title_zh: 小微企业成长，消费者是否受益？来自智利小微企业大额贷款的证据
title_primary: 小微企业成长，消费者是否受益？来自智利小微企业大额贷款的证据
title_secondary: When Microenterprises Grow, Are Consumers Better Off? Evidence from Large Loans to Microenterprises in Chile
authors: Dean Karlan, Natalia Rigol, Benjamin N. Roth
official: 官方在线 2026-09-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Evaluations of microenterprise credit typically measure effects only on borrowing firms. But what about their customers? If microenterprises sell relatively undifferentiated goods and services, as is often hypothesized, credit may simply reallocate sales across firms and create little consumer benefit. In a randomized controlled trial in Chile, large loans increased treated firms’ profits by USD 292 per month, a 13.4% increase. Customer survey data indicate even larger benefits for customers: a gain of USD 494 per month in consumer surplus. Furthermore, using a sample of more than 125,000 non-treated firms operating in the same markets, we find little evidence of business stealing. The welfare gains from credit expansion thus extend well beyond the borrowers themselves.
abstract_zh: 微型企业信贷的评估通常仅衡量对借款企业的影响。但借款企业的客户呢？如果微型企业销售的商品和服务相对同质化，正如常被假设的那样，信贷可能仅仅在厂商之间重新分配销售额，而对消费者几乎不产生益处。在智利进行的一项随机对照试验中，大额贷款使受助企业的月利润增加了292美元，增幅达13.4%。客户调查数据显示，客户获得的益处甚至更大：消费者剩余每月增加494美元。此外，利用同一市场中超过12.5万家未受助企业的样本，我们几乎没有发现业务侵占的证据。因此，信贷扩张带来的福利收益远不止于借款者本身。

title: Social Mobility among Christian Africans: Evidence from Anglican Marriage Registers in Uganda, 1895-2011
title_zh: 基督教非洲人的社会流动：来自乌干达圣公会婚姻登记册的证据，1895-2011年
title_primary: 基督教非洲人的社会流动：来自乌干达圣公会婚姻登记册的证据，1895-2011年
title_secondary: Social Mobility among Christian Africans: Evidence from Anglican Marriage Registers in Uganda, 1895-2011
authors: Felix Meier zu Selhausen, Marco van Leeuwen, Jacob Weisdorf
official: 官方在线 2017-01-11 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This article uses Anglican marriage registers from colonial and post-colonial Uganda to investigate long-term trends and determinants of intergenerational social mobility among Christian African men. We show that the colonial era opened up new labour opportunities for our African converts enabling them to take large steps up the social ladder regardless of their social origin. Contrary to the widespread belief that British indirect rule perpetuated the power of pre-colonial African elites, we show that a remarkably fluid colonial labour economy actually undermined their social advantages. Sons of traditional landed chiefs gradually lost their high social-status monopoly to a new commercially-orientated and well-educated class of Anglican Ugandans, who mostly came from non-elite and even lower-class backgrounds. We also document that the colonial administration and the Anglican mission functioned as key steps on the ladder to upward mobility, and that mission education helped provide the skills and social reference needed to climb it. These social mobility patterns persisted throughout the post-colonial era despite rising informal labour during Idi Amin’s dictatorship.
abstract_zh: 本文利用殖民时期及后殖民时期乌干达的英国国教婚姻登记记录，探讨基督教非洲男性代际社会流动的长期趋势及其决定因素。研究表明，殖民时代为非洲皈依者开辟了新的劳动机会，使他们能够不论出身背景，在社会阶梯上实现大幅跃升。与普遍认为英国间接统治延续了前殖民时期非洲精英权力的观点相反，本文揭示，一个高度流动的殖民劳动经济实际上削弱了这些精英的社会优势。传统地主酋长之子逐渐丧失其高社会地位的垄断，取而代之的是一个以商业为导向且受过良好教育的乌干达英国国教徒新阶层，他们大多出身于非精英甚至下层背景。本文还记录到，殖民行政机构与英国国教传教团充当了向上流动阶梯中的关键环节，而传教教育则提供了攀登这一阶梯所需的技能与社会参照。这些社会流动模式在后殖民时期持续存在，尽管在伊迪·阿明独裁统治期间非正规劳动有所增加。

title: Risk premia reconsidered: Illiquidity and selection bias for stocks and corporate bonds in the pre‐First World War period
title_zh: 风险溢价再探讨：第一次世界大战前股票与公司债券的流动性不足与选择偏差
title_primary: 风险溢价再探讨：第一次世界大战前股票与公司债券的流动性不足与选择偏差
title_secondary: Risk premia reconsidered: Illiquidity and selection bias for stocks and corporate bonds in the pre‐First World War period
authors: Justin Case, Eline Poelmans, Gertjan Verdickt
official: 官方在线 2026-08-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Financial history is plagued by a visibility trap. Using the Brussels Stock Exchange (1850–1913), we demonstrate that asset illiquidity introduced selection bias, which systematically inflated historical risk premia. Applying a latent return model, we argue that correcting for this illiquidity decreases the equity and corporate bond risk premia and collapses the risk–return relationship. We show that the assets that were more exposed to selection bias underperformed in subsequent months. We identify two institutional drivers of this phenomenon: censored price lists curated by the financial media and the exchange's policy to cease publishing bids and ask quotes in its official price lists from 1889 onwards.
abstract_zh: 金融历史深受一种“可见性陷阱”的困扰。利用布鲁塞尔证券交易所（1850-1913年）的数据，我们证明资产流动性不足引入了选择偏差，这系统性地抬高了历史风险溢价。通过应用潜在收益模型，我们认为纠正这一流动性不足会降低股票和公司债券的风险溢价，并使风险-收益关系趋于消失。我们显示，那些更易受选择偏差影响的资产在随后几个月中表现不佳。我们识别出这一现象的两个制度性驱动因素：金融媒体策划的删减价格列表，以及交易所自1889年起停止在其官方价格列表中公布买卖报价的政策。

title: Standards Harmonization and Institutional Quality in Exporting Countries
title_zh: 标准协调与出口国制度质量
title_primary: 标准协调与出口国制度质量
title_secondary: Standards Harmonization and Institutional Quality in Exporting Countries
authors: Anirudh Shingal
official: 官方在线 2026-08-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The existing literature has documented the positive impact of standards harmonization in the importing country on trade, but it has not examined whether better institutional quality in exporting countries helps enhance the gains from this harmonization. Combining disaggregated trade data with data on maximum residue levels (MRLs) in pesticides, we exploit the EU's 2008 harmonization of pesticides MRLs to study the impact of institutional quality in non‐EU exporting countries on EU imports of horticultural products from these countries over 2005–2014 in a structural gravity framework. We find that multiple dimensions of institutional quality—government effectiveness, regulatory quality and rule of law, which reflect institutional capacity to implement and enforce harmonized standards and ensure transparency, and control of corruption that fosters trust between trading partners—enhance the positive impact of harmonization on the probability of exporting to the EU. However, a similar effect on export value is found to be inconclusive.
abstract_zh: 现有文献已证实进口国标准协调对贸易的积极影响，但尚未考察出口国制度质量是否有助于增强这种协调带来的收益。结合细分贸易数据与农药最大残留限量（MRLs）数据，我们利用欧盟2008年农药MRLs协调政策，在结构引力模型框架下，研究了2005—2014年间非欧盟出口国制度质量对欧盟从这些国家进口园艺产品的影响。研究发现，制度质量的多个维度——政府效能、监管质量和法治水平，这些反映制度能力以实施和执行协调标准并确保透明度，以及控制腐败以促进贸易伙伴间信任——均能增强协调对向欧盟出口概率的积极影响。然而，对出口价值的类似影响则未得到明确结论。

title: AI in a Fragmenting World
title_zh: 碎片化世界中的AI
title_primary: 碎片化世界中的AI
title_secondary: AI in a Fragmenting World
authors: Barry Eichengreen, George Cui, Asmaa A. El-Ganainy, Yevgeniya Koriyenko, Elyad Shojaei 等
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We link two global trends—AI and geoeconomic fragmentation—asking how fragmentation affects the international diffusion of AI, the magnitude of gains, and their distribution across economies. We ask these questions in general but also with a focus on the MENAP economies. While the effects of AI are potentially far-reaching, the benefits are neither guaranteed nor even. Frontier AI innovation is concentrated in a small number of economies, while countries benefiting through supply-chain participation or AI adoption—with outcomes shaped by their position in global trade and production networks and their AI preparedness. Geoeconomic fragmentation slows AI diffusion and reshapes its distribution by raising trade costs, restricting technology and data flows, fragmenting digital services, and reducing cross-border investment and collaboration. Yet proactive policy choices can turn this dynamic: economies that position themselves as connectors—maintaining trade and technology links across multiple partners—can potentially capture diverted flows and outperform even the no-fragmentation benchmark. For the MENAP economies, diversified links with all major technology hubs can cushion the effects of fragmentation and provide a structural foundation to emerge as net beneficiaries of AI diffusion, but realizing that potential requires reducing AI-related trade costs, improving AI preparedness, and building local AI-related capacity.
abstract_zh: 我们将两大全球趋势——人工智能与地缘经济碎片化——联系起来，探讨碎片化如何影响人工智能的国际扩散、收益规模及其在各经济体间的分布。我们不仅从一般意义上提出这些问题，还特别关注中东、北非及阿富汗、巴基斯坦（MENAP）经济体。尽管人工智能的影响可能深远，但其益处既非必然也非均衡。前沿人工智能创新集中于少数经济体，而其他国家则通过参与供应链或采用人工智能获益——其结果受制于它们在全球贸易和生产网络中的地位及其人工智能准备度。地缘经济碎片化通过提高贸易成本、限制技术和数据流动、分割数字服务以及减少跨境投资与合作，减缓了人工智能的扩散并重塑其分布格局。然而，主动的政策选择可以扭转这一态势：那些将自己定位为连接者——与多个伙伴保持贸易和技术联系——的经济体，有可能捕获转移的流动，甚至超越无碎片化基准下的表现。对于MENAP经济体而言，与所有主要技术中心建立多元化联系可以缓冲碎片化的影响，并为成为人工智能扩散的净受益者提供结构性基础，但实现这一潜力需要降低与人工智能相关的贸易成本、提升人工智能准备度，并建设本地人工智能相关能力。

title: Testing for common latent factors across two short panels
title_zh: 检验两个短面板中的共同潜在因子
title_primary: 检验两个短面板中的共同潜在因子
title_secondary: Testing for common latent factors across two short panels
authors: Alain-Philippe Fortin
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper develops inference tools for the number of common latent factors across two large cross-sectional panels observed over a short time span (large n, small T). Our approach builds on a general test for determining the dimension of the intersection of two matrix column spaces, where each matrix is estimated with noise. The proposed test statistics are based on canonical correlations, and their asymptotic distributions are derived via perturbation methods. An empirical application to large cross-sections of monthly US stock returns and corporate bond returns finds that, on average, five latent factors influence both asset classes over an 18-month period. Our results suggest that a plausible candidate for a common factor is a stock portfolio with weights sorted on book leverage. Overall, the common factors between the two asset classes behave more like stock characteristic portfolios than bond characteristic portfolios, both in terms of pricing performance and time series dynamics.
abstract_zh: 本文开发了针对两个大型横截面面板在短时间跨度内（大n，小T）共同潜在因子数量的推断工具。我们的方法基于一个通用检验，用于确定两个矩阵列空间交集的维度，其中每个矩阵均含噪声估计。所提出的检验统计量基于典型相关，其渐近分布通过扰动方法推导得出。一项对月度美国股票回报和企业债券回报的大型横截面的实证应用发现，平均而言，在18个月期间内有五个潜在因子影响这两类资产。我们的结果表明，一个可能的共同因子候选是依据账面杠杆排序权重的股票组合。总体而言，这两类资产之间的共同因子在定价表现和时间序列动态方面，更类似于股票特征组合而非债券特征组合。

title: Consumer surplus and privatization in vertically related markets
title_zh: 垂直相关市场中的消费者剩余与私有化
title_primary: 垂直相关市场中的消费者剩余与私有化
title_secondary: Consumer surplus and privatization in vertically related markets
authors: Priyanka Dutta, Arghya Ghosh, Tridip Ray
official: 官方在线 2026-08-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study privatization in vertically related markets through the lens of consumer surplus, focusing on the optimality of mixed ownership regimes. We consider a successive monopoly in which both upstream and downstream sectors consist either of profit-maximizing private firms or welfare-maximizing but relatively inefficient public firms. When markups are either very high or very low, mixed regimes are intermediate, ranking neither best nor worst in terms of consumer surplus. In contrast to standard results for symmetric single-stage oligopolies, mixed regimes can maximize consumer surplus in vertical settings when market power is moderate and public firms’ inefficiency relative to private firms differs sufficiently across sectors. In such cases, selection is crucial: consumer surplus is maximized by privatizing only the sector in which public firms are relatively more inefficient. While our primary focus is on consumer surplus and successive monopoly, we also examine welfare and competition. Welfare rankings largely mirror consumer surplus rankings, except that, relative to consumer surplus, the private (public) regime is more likely to rank highest (lowest) under the welfare criterion. Downstream competition expands the parameter range over which mixed ownership maximizes consumer surplus. In the presence of competition in both upstream and downstream sectors, either mixed regime—that is, privatizing either sector alone—can maximize consumer surplus, regardless of the public–private efficiency gap, provided the privatized sector is sufficiently more competitive than the vertically related sector.
abstract_zh: 我们从消费者剩余的视角研究纵向关联市场中的私有化问题，聚焦于混合所有制安排的最优性。我们考虑一个连续垄断模型，其中上游和下游部门均由追求利润最大化的私营企业或追求福利最大化但相对低效的公共企业构成。当加成率极高或极低时，混合所有制处于中间状态，在消费者剩余方面既非最优也非最劣。与对称单阶段寡头市场的标准结论不同，在纵向结构中，当市场势力适中且公共企业相对于私营企业的低效程度在各部门间存在足够差异时，混合所有制能够最大化消费者剩余。在此类情形下，选择至关重要：消费者剩余最大化要求仅对公共企业相对更低效的部门进行私有化。尽管我们的主要关注点是消费者剩余和连续垄断，我们也考察了福利与竞争。福利排序在很大程度上与消费者剩余排序一致，但相对于消费者剩余标准，在福利标准下，私营（公共）所有制更可能排名最高（最低）。下游竞争扩大了混合所有制能够最大化消费者剩余的参数范围。当上游和下游部门均存在竞争时，任一混合所有制——即仅对任一部门进行私有化——都能最大化消费者剩余，无论公私效率差距如何，前提是被私有化的部门相对于纵向关联部门具有足够的竞争性。

title: Liquidity Crises and the Market‐Maker of Last Resort
title_zh: 流动性危机与最后做市商
title_primary: 流动性危机与最后做市商
title_secondary: Liquidity Crises and the Market‐Maker of Last Resort
authors: Charles M. Kahn, David A. Marshall, Robert L. McDonald
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-07-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study market illiquidity in an economy subject to nonfundamental shocks. Asset trading occurs via decentralized bargaining. The model has multiple rational expectations equilibria; we associate certain Pareto‐inferior equilibria with liquidity crises. The government can improve welfare by acting as a “market‐maker of last resort” (MMLR), purchasing assets at above‐market prices. Several policies employed by the United States during the financial crisis are examples of MMLR. We consider “aggressive” and “conservative” MMLR policies. The aggressive policy supports the unique Pareto‐optimal equilibrium. The conservative policy, which embeds a “no‐bailout constraint,” only supports an inefficient equilibrium.
abstract_zh: 本文研究在遭受非基本面冲击的经济体中的市场非流动性问题。资产交易通过分散化议价进行。该模型存在多重理性预期均衡；我们将某些帕累托劣等均衡与流动性危机相关联。政府可通过充当“最后做市商”（MMLR），以高于市场的价格购买资产来改善社会福利。美国在金融危机期间采取的若干政策即为MMLR的实例。我们考察了“激进型”与“保守型”两种MMLR政策。激进型政策支持唯一的帕累托最优均衡，而嵌入“不救助约束”的保守型政策仅能维持无效率的均衡。

abstract: Australia's natural environment has been devastated by decades of land clearing, habitat destruction, invasive species and climate change—and the economics discipline has largely looked the other way. In November 2025, the Australian Parliament passed landmark amendments to the Environmental Protection and Biodiversity Conservation (EPBC) Act. These reforms are a game‐changer—but they are just a start. Restoration at scale must follow, properly funded and integrated with climate policy; anything less is a betrayal of future generations. Rebuilding natural capital is not a discretionary amenity. For this and every subsequent generation of Australians, it is a matter of survival.
abstract_zh: 澳大利亚的自然环境因数十年的土地开垦、栖息地破坏、入侵物种和气候变化而遭受重创——而经济学学科在很大程度上对此视而不见。2025年11月，澳大利亚议会通过了《环境保护与生物多样性保护法》（EPBC Act）具有里程碑意义的修正案。这些改革是颠覆性的变革——但这仅仅是开始。必须随之开展大规模生态修复，并确保资金充足且与气候政策相整合；任何不足都是对子孙后代的背叛。重建自然资本并非可选择的便利设施。对于这一代及未来每一代澳大利亚人而言，这关乎生存。

title: Sexual identity, industrial segregation and earnings
title_zh: 性取向、行业隔离与收入
title_primary: 性取向、行业隔离与收入
title_secondary: Sexual identity, industrial segregation and earnings
authors: Samuel Mann, Nigel O’Leary, David Blackaby
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Using longitudinal data from the UK, we study the role of industrial segregation for sexual identity-based pay disparities, while controlling for fixed unobserved heterogeneity. We show that industries that have a greater proportion of sexual minorities pay their male employees less. This is of an order of magnitude of a 0.6% marginal reduction in earnings as industrial representation of sexual minorities increases by 1 percent. This compares to an equivalent marginal figure for occupational segregation of approximately 0.9%. In contrast, there is a protective element present for females in the public sector who benefit from a within industry premium to locating in industries with greater LGB representation. However, such effects do not remove the substantial wage penalty faced by gay men, and by lesbian women in the private sector.
abstract_zh: 利用英国纵向数据，我们研究了行业隔离对基于性取向的薪酬差异的作用，同时控制了固定的不可观测异质性。我们表明，性少数群体占比更高的行业支付给男性员工的薪酬较低。当行业中的性少数群体代表性增加1%时，男性员工收入边际减少约0.6%。这与职业隔离的相应边际数值约0.9%相比。相反，在公共部门，女性存在一种保护性因素，她们因进入LGB代表性更高的行业而享有行业内溢价。然而，这些效应并未消除男同性恋者以及私营部门女同性恋者所面临的显著工资惩罚。

title: Fickle fossils: Economic growth, coal, and the European oil invasion, 1900–2015
title_zh: 易变化石：经济增长、煤炭与欧洲石油入侵，1900–2015
title_primary: 易变化石：经济增长、煤炭与欧洲石油入侵，1900–2015
title_secondary: Fickle fossils: Economic growth, coal, and the European oil invasion, 1900–2015
authors: Miriam Fritzsche, Nikolaus Wolf
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Fossil fuels have shaped the European economy since the industrial revolution. We use new long-run panel data to analyse the effect of both, coal and oil on economic growth between 1900 and 2015, exploiting variation at the level of European NUTS2 and NUTS3 regions. We show that the reversal of fortune of coal regions resulted from the second energy transition. Specifically, an “oil invasion” in the early 1960s turned regional coal abundance from a blessing into a curse. Human capital accumulation contributed to this reversal of fortune and fully explains the negative effects until today. Moreover, we find substantial heterogeneity between former coal regions that is in line with Glaeser’s “reinvention hypothesis”: regions with a higher skill-level adjusted much better to the decline of coal. In particular, we show that coal regions with a higher urban density before 1800 were much more resilient than others.
abstract_zh: 自工业革命以来，化石燃料深刻塑造了欧洲经济。我们利用新的长期面板数据，以欧洲NUTS2和NUTS3区域为分析单元，考察了1900年至2015年间煤炭与石油对经济增长的影响。研究表明，煤炭产区的命运逆转源于第二次能源转型。具体而言，20世纪60年代初期的"石油入侵"使区域煤炭禀赋从福音转变为诅咒。人力资本积累促成了这一命运逆转，并完全解释了直至今日的负面效应。此外，我们发现前煤炭产区之间存在显著异质性，这与格莱泽的"再造假说"一致：技能水平较高的区域对煤炭产业衰退的适应能力显著更强。特别值得注意的是，1800年前城市密度较高的煤炭产区展现出远超其他地区的经济韧性。

title: Beyond costs: The dominant role of strategic complementarities in pricing
title_zh: 超越成本：战略互补性在定价中的主导作用
title_primary: 超越成本：战略互补性在定价中的主导作用
title_secondary: Beyond costs: The dominant role of strategic complementarities in pricing
authors: E. Albagli, Francesco Grigoli, Emiliano Luttini, Dagoberto Quevedo, Marco Rojas
official: 官方在线 2026-07-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper documents five empirical facts about the role of strategic complementarities in firms’ price-setting behavior, using administrative data on Chilean firms. (1) Strategic complementarities play a dominant role in price setting, exerting a stronger influence than changes in marginal costs. (2) While the strength of strategic complementarities varies across sectors, it consistently outweighs the role of cost changes. (3) In high-inflation environments, firms become more responsive to changes in their competitors’ prices. (4) Firms respond more strongly to competitors’ price increases than to price decreases, mirroring the ‘rockets and feathers’ phenomenon of costs. (5) Strategic complementarities are stronger among firms with fewer competitors, larger market shares, and broader customer bases. These findings suggest that strategic complementarities — a source of real rigidities — are quantitatively important, state-dependent, asymmetric, and shaped by market structure.
abstract_zh: 本文利用智利企业的行政数据，记录了关于战略性互补在企业定价行为中作用的五项实证事实。（1）战略性互补在定价中占据主导地位，其影响力超过边际成本变化。（2）尽管战略性互补的强度在不同行业间存在差异，但其作用始终超过成本变化的影响。（3）在高通胀环境下，企业对竞争对手价格变动的反应更为敏感。（4）企业对竞争对手提价的反应强于对降价的反应，这反映了成本变动的“火箭与羽毛”现象。（5）在竞争对手较少、市场份额较大且客户基础更广的企业中，战略性互补更为显著。这些发现表明，战略性互补——作为实际刚性的来源——在数量上具有重要意义，具有状态依赖性、非对称性，并受市场结构影响。

title: Investor expertise and private investment selection
title_zh: 投资者专长与私人投资选择
title_primary: 投资者专长与私人投资选择
title_secondary: Investor expertise and private investment selection
authors: Shane Miller, Emmanuel Yimfor, Ye Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Institutional and individual investors evaluate private market opportunities systematically differently, even facing identical choices. In a survey experiment, 593 institutional and 445 individual investors assess venture capital fund profiles with independently randomized GP characteristics. Institutions heavily weight past fund performance, consistent with risk-averse investor demand calibrated to VC markets. Individuals largely ignore performance, favoring educational credentials instead. A follow-up experiment identifies two independent mechanisms: individuals lack awareness that VC performance persists and discount quality signals for funds they perceive as inaccessible. Performance-based selection alone reduces individuals’ expected returns by approximately 7%, accounting for 20% of the return gap with professionals.
abstract_zh: 机构投资者与个人投资者在面对相同的私募市场机会时，其评估方式存在系统性差异。在一项调查实验中，593名机构投资者与445名个人投资者对风险投资基金概况进行了评估，其中普通合伙人特征被独立随机化。机构投资者高度重视过往基金业绩，这与风险投资市场中风险规避型投资者需求相吻合。相比之下，个人投资者则基本忽视业绩表现，转而偏好教育背景资质。后续实验揭示了两个独立机制：个人投资者既缺乏对风险投资业绩持续性的认知，又对自认为难以触及的基金质量信号持折扣态度。仅基于业绩的选择机制便使个人投资者的预期收益降低约7%，这解释了其与专业人士之间约20%的收益差距。

title: Reassessing the Role of Standardized Tests in University Admissions
title_zh: 重新评估标准化考试在大学招生中的作用
title_primary: 重新评估标准化考试在大学招生中的作用
title_secondary: Reassessing the Role of Standardized Tests in University Admissions
authors: Johann D. Gaebler, Calvin Isley, Christopher Avery, Sharad Goel
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: There is a long-running debate over using standardized test scores to inform college and graduate admissions decisions, with some arguing that test scores are an important signal of academic strength and others arguing that they are biased and exclusionary. Here we revisit this issue by analyzing a novel dataset of more than 13,000 applications over roughly a decade to a large public policy master’s program in the United States. Consistent with past work, we find that GRE scores substantially improve predictions of first-year grades relative to predictions based on GPA alone. However, when these predictions are used to inform admissions decisions, we find that test scores only modestly improve the expected academic quality of admitted students. The gap shrinks further when we augment the test-aware and test-blind predictive models with more fine-grained information available in student transcripts and other application materials. Specifically, we estimate that incorporating standardized test scores in our setting would result in admitting students who perform, on average, only 0.03 grade points better. We show—both empirically and theoretically—that this pattern stems from a subtle distinction between predictions and decisions. Even with improved predictions, the downstream admissions decisions are often the same; and where there are differences, they often involve selecting between similarly qualified applicants. Our results indicate that standardized test scores may be less important for university admissions than previously suggested.
abstract_zh: 关于是否应将标准化考试成绩作为大学及研究生招生依据的争论由来已久。一方认为考试成绩是衡量学术能力的重要指标，另一方则指出其存在偏见与排斥性。本研究通过分析美国某大型公共政策硕士项目十余年间逾13,000份申请数据重新审视该问题。与既往研究一致，我们发现相较于仅依据GPA的预测模型，加入GRE成绩能显著提升对一年级学业成绩的预测精度。然而当将这些预测结果用于招生决策时，考试成绩对录取学生预期学术质量的提升作用有限。当我们在考虑/不考虑考试成绩的预测模型中进一步纳入成绩单及其他申请材料中的精细化信息时，这种差距进一步缩小。具体而言，本情境下引入标准化考试成绩仅能使录取学生的平均绩点提升0.03分。我们通过实证与理论分析表明，这一现象源于预测与决策之间的微妙差异：即便预测精度有所提升，下游招生决策往往保持不变；即便存在差异，也通常涉及资质相近的申请者之间的选择。研究结果表明，标准化考试成绩对大学招生的实际影响可能低于此前文献的论断。

abstract: We propose a text-based measure of monetary policy stance that models FOMC statements as convex combinations of dovish and hawkish alternatives, providing a tractable representation of the Committee's position along the policy spectrum. Leveraging staff-drafted alternative statements, we fine-tune a pretrained language model to capture both quantitative precision and semantic tone. Stance is defined as the product of tone and novelty, and decomposed into expected and surprise components using high-frequency financial data. Surprises arise from shifts in tone relative to expectations or from statement novelty. Our framework enables counterfactuals showing how alternative communication could have moved markets. (JEL D83, D84, E31, E32, E43, E52, E58)
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种基于文本的货币政策立场衡量方法，将联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）声明建模为鸽派与鹰派选项的凸组合，从而为委员会在政策谱系中的立场提供可处理的表征。利用工作人员起草的备选声明，我们对预训练语言模型进行微调，以同时捕捉量化精确性与语义基调。立场被定义为基调与新颖性的乘积，并借助高频金融数据分解为预期成分与意外成分。意外成分源于相对于预期的基调变化或声明的新颖性。我们的框架能够实现反事实分析，展示替代性沟通方式如何影响市场走势。（JEL分类号：D83, D84, E31, E32, E43, E52, E58）

abstract: This paper develops a framework in which university research depends endogenously on competition for tuition and talented students in the market for higher education. When students are highly stratified across colleges, or when tuition rises sharply with school rank, universities spend on R&D even if the direct contribution of research to teaching is small. The model is consistent with causal evidence and matches new features of the microdata. It explains why universities internally fund research with tuition, despite negligible returns to patenting. Calibrated simulations suggest that existing tuition policies boost university research while research subsidies crowd it out. (JEL I22, I23, L24, O31, O34)
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个分析框架，其中大学研究内生于高等教育市场中争夺学费与优秀学生的竞争。当学生高度分层于不同院校，或学费随学校排名急剧上升时，即使研究对教学的直接贡献微乎其微，大学仍会投入研发。该模型与因果证据一致，并匹配了微观数据的新特征。它解释了为何大学会利用学费内部资助研究，尽管专利化回报微不足道。校准模拟表明，现行学费政策促进了大学研究，而研究补贴反而产生了挤出效应。（JEL I22, I23, L24, O31, O34）

abstract: Wealthier, risk-averse buyers pay more to speed up transactions in competitive search markets. This, coupled with forward-looking intermediaries who hold vacant homes overnight, implies that a credit expansion produces a boom in prices that slowly recedes over time. This boom is due to a combination of two effects. First, search and matching frictions imply that buyers are willing to pay a higher price to trade faster, not only to consume housing services. Second, the fact that intermediaries are forward-looking implies that trading probabilities today depend on the future evolution of prices. Since agents forecast that prices are higher than in the initial steady state, they turn to trading today. Our theory produces a boom in prices that slowly recedes and a gradual rise of homeownership rate.
abstract_zh: 更富裕且风险规避的买家在竞争性搜索市场中愿意支付更高价格以加速交易。这一现象，加之持有空置房屋过夜的具有前瞻性的中介机构，意味着信贷扩张会引发价格繁荣，随后随时间缓慢回落。这种繁荣源于两种效应的结合。首先，搜索与匹配摩擦意味着买家不仅为了消费住房服务，还为了更快达成交易而愿意支付更高价格。其次，中介机构的前瞻性意味着今日的交易概率取决于价格的未来走势。由于主体预测价格高于初始稳态水平，他们转向今日交易。我们的理论产生了价格缓慢回落及住房拥有率逐步上升的繁荣景象。

official: 官方在线 2026-06-12 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We quantify barriers to cross-border banking within the euro area and their consequences for credit allocation and output. Using loan-level data from the European credit registry (AnaCredit) and group structures (RIAD), we estimate barriers to relationship formation, loan pricing, and banks’ branching decisions at the country-pair level. We find that barriers to cross-border relationships between banks and firms and cross-border bank entry are large while wedges on interest rates and loan quantities are comparatively small. The estimated edges are strongly associated with differences in national banking regulations, measured using a novel dataset on regulatory distances. We embed our estimates into a quantitative spatial general equilibrium model with heterogeneous banks and firms subject to cross-border frictions in relationship formation, loan pricing, and bank entry. Partially relaxing frictions predicts sizable and heterogeneous output gains across euro area countries. These gains are primarily driven by increases in capital and labor rather than improvements in allocative efficiency.
abstract_zh: 我们量化了欧元区内跨境银行业务的障碍及其对信贷配置和产出的影响。利用欧洲信贷登记系统（AnaCredit）的贷款层面数据和集团结构数据（RIAD），我们在国家-国家配对层面估计了关系建立、贷款定价以及银行分支决策的障碍。研究发现，银行与企业之间的跨境关系建立以及跨境银行进入的障碍较大，而利率和贷款数量的楔子相对较小。这些估计的楔子与各国银行业监管差异（通过一套新的监管距离数据集衡量）密切相关。我们将这些估计嵌入一个包含异质性银行和企业的定量空间一般均衡模型中，该模型考虑了关系建立、贷款定价和银行进入方面的跨境摩擦。部分放松这些摩擦预计将在欧元区各国带来显著且异质性的产出增长。这些增长主要源于资本和劳动的增加，而非配置效率的改善。

title: Playing it Safe? The Effect of Abortion Bans on Sexual Behavior
title_zh: 谨慎行事？堕胎禁令对性行为的影响
title_primary: 谨慎行事？堕胎禁令对性行为的影响
title_secondary: Playing it Safe? The Effect of Abortion Bans on Sexual Behavior
authors: James M. Flynn, David R. Munro, Caitlin K. Myers
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We estimate the effect of total abortion bans enacted after Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health on sexual behavior. Using synthetic and standard difference-in-differences designs, we analyze gonorrhea rates and over-the-counter contraceptive purchases as indicators of sexual activity and contraceptive use. We find that total abortion bans reduced gonorrhea rates by 21% among the population aged 15–44 and increased condom purchases by 5.4%. County-level analyses suggest the response reflects awareness of state policy rather than changes in travel distance to providers. These findings are consistent with a framework in which abortion restrictions increase the perceived cost of unprotected sex, inducing more cautious behavior.
abstract_zh: 我们估算了多布斯诉杰克逊妇女健康组织案后实施全面堕胎禁令对性行为的影响。采用合成双重差分法和标准双重差分法，我们以淋病发病率和非处方避孕药具购买量作为性行为活跃度及避孕措施使用的指标进行分析。研究发现，全面堕胎禁令使15-44岁人群的淋病发病率降低21%，避孕套购买量增加5.4%。县级层面分析表明，这一反应源于对州政策的认知，而非前往医疗服务机构出行距离的变化。这些发现与以下理论框架一致：堕胎限制提高了无保护性行为的感知成本，从而促使人们采取更谨慎的行为。

title: Impact of Cooperative Membership on Maize Harvest Losses in China
title_zh: 合作社成员身份对中国玉米收获损失的影响
title_primary: 合作社成员身份对中国玉米收获损失的影响
title_secondary: Impact of Cooperative Membership on Maize Harvest Losses in China
authors: Yi Luo, Xue Qu, Haimin Miao, Laping Wu
official: 官方在线 2026-06-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Countries are accelerating actions to reduce food loss and waste to ensure global food security and sustainable development. Cooperatives are considered important channels for promoting the use of agricultural technologies and improving farmers' skills, which are regarded as key factors in reducing harvest losses. However, owing to data limitations, few systematic assessments of the effects of cooperative membership on food losses exist. On the basis of survey data from 703 maize growers in three major maize production areas in China, propensity score matching (PSM) and endogenous switching regression (ESR) were used in this study to evaluate the effects of cooperative membership on the maize harvest losses of households. The results revealed that membership significantly reduced maize harvest losses by 68%, saving farmers an average of 238.05 kg per ha, which is worth $91.92 per ha. Membership also contributed to minor pest attacks and better working attitudes during the harvest stage. Cooperative membership is critically important for China's food security, resource conservation, and environmental protection. If the average maize harvest loss reaches the level of loss observed among member households, then it is possible to meet the food consumption needs of 13.61 million people, saving 0.74 million ha of land and 0.29 million tons of fertilizer used for maize production and reducing carbon emissions by 4.04 million tons and the water footprint by 6.43 billion m 3 .
abstract_zh: 各国正加速行动减少粮食损失与浪费，以保障全球粮食安全与可持续发展。合作社被视为推广农业技术、提升农户技能的重要渠道，而这两者被认为是降低收获损失的关键因素。然而，受数据限制，关于合作社成员身份对粮食损失影响的系统性评估仍较为匮乏。本研究基于中国三大玉米主产区703户玉米种植户的调查数据，采用倾向得分匹配（PSM）与内生转换回归（ESR）方法，评估合作社成员身份对农户玉米收获损失的影响。结果表明：成员身份显著降低了68%的玉米收获损失，平均每公顷为农户节省238.05公斤，折合每公顷91.92美元。此外，成员身份还有助于减少收获阶段的虫害侵袭，并改善农户的工作态度。合作社成员身份对中国粮食安全、资源节约与环境保护具有关键意义。若玉米平均收获损失降至成员农户的水平，则可满足1360万人的粮食消费需求，节省74万公顷土地及29万吨玉米生产用化肥，减少404万吨碳排放，并降低64.3亿立方米的水足迹。

title: Institution, major and firm‐specific premia: Evidence from administrative data
title_zh: 制度、专业与企业特定溢价：基于行政数据的证据
title_primary: 制度、专业与企业特定溢价：基于行政数据的证据
title_secondary: Institution, major and firm‐specific premia: Evidence from administrative data
authors: Ben Ost, Weixiang Pan, Douglas Webber
official: 官方在线 2026-05-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We examine how a student's field of degree and institution attended contribute to the labour market outcomes of young graduates. Administrative panel data that combines student transcripts with matched employer‐employee records allow us to provide the first decomposition of premia into individual‐ and firm‐specific components. We find that both major and institutional premia are more strongly related to the firm‐specific component of wages than the individual‐specific component of wages. On average, a student's major is a more important predictor of future wages than the selectivity of the institution attended, but major premia (and their relative ranking) can differ substantially across institutions, suggesting the importance of program‐level data for prospective students and their parents.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了学生的专业领域及所就读院校如何影响年轻毕业生的劳动力市场表现。通过结合学生成绩单与匹配的雇主-雇员记录的行政面板数据，我们首次将溢价分解为个人特定和公司特定组成部分。研究发现，无论是专业还是院校溢价，都与工资的公司特定组成部分关联更强，而非个人特定组成部分。平均而言，学生的专业对未来工资的预测力强于所就读院校的选拔性，但专业溢价（及其相对排名）在不同院校间可能存在显著差异，这表明对于潜在学生及其家长而言，项目层面的数据至关重要。

title: Experimental methods: Revisiting the commandments of experimental economics
title_zh: 实验方法：重访实验经济学的基本准则
title_primary: 实验方法：重访实验经济学的基本准则
title_secondary: Experimental methods: Revisiting the commandments of experimental economics
authors: Uri Gneezy
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: More than half a century ago, experimental economists came up with a set of rigorous methodological principles that revolutionized the way economists think—and that have defined the field ever since. Pivotal among them are the no-deception norm, the use of abstract instructions, induced-value theory, and the use of incentives in experiments. In this paper I revisit these principles, critically examining their origins and justifications, and explore their stand in current research, given the new challenges posed by online experiments, cross-disciplinary spillovers, and the evolving landscape of behavioral research. I conclude that we have become too rigidly attached to our methodologies and should adopt a more flexible, context-sensitive, and less-dogmatic approach.
abstract_zh: 半个多世纪前，实验经济学家提出了一套严谨的方法论原则，彻底改变了经济学家的思维方式，并自此定义了该领域。其中关键原则包括不欺骗规范、使用抽象指令、诱导价值理论以及在实验中使用激励措施。本文重新审视这些原则，批判性地探讨其起源与合理性，并考察它们在当前研究中的地位，鉴于在线实验、跨学科溢出效应以及行为研究不断演变的格局所带来的新挑战。我得出结论，我们已过于僵化地固守方法论，应当采取更为灵活、情境敏感且较少教条化的方法。

title: From certification to agglomeration: Evidence from geographical indications of agricultural products in China
title_zh: 从认证到集聚：来自中国农产品地理标志的证据
title_primary: 从认证到集聚：来自中国农产品地理标志的证据
title_secondary: From certification to agglomeration: Evidence from geographical indications of agricultural products in China
authors: Zhaofeng Tan, Teng Huang, Tianjun Liu, Xinshuang Zhang, Ziqing Tian
official: 官方在线 2026-04-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract Marshallian agglomeration is typically attributed to input–output linkages, labor market pooling, and knowledge spillovers; however, empirical evidence on how these mechanisms operate in agricultural settings remains limited. This paper examines whether and how China's agricultural geographical indications certification fosters agricultural agglomeration. Exploiting the staggered rollout of this certification system since 2008 as a quasi‐natural experiment, we employ a staggered difference‐in‐differences design and find that certification significantly promotes county‐level agricultural agglomeration, primarily through strengthened input–output linkages: it encourages the colocation of upstream producers and downstream processors and deepens local production networks. In contrast, we find no significant effects through labor market pooling or knowledge spillovers. The agglomeration effects are concentrated in plant‐based certifications and are stronger in counties with better market access and transportation infrastructure. Overall, our findings extend Marshallian agglomeration theory to agriculture and provide new causal evidence on how agricultural geographical indications certification contributes to agricultural agglomeration as part of broader sectoral structural transformation.
abstract_zh: 马歇尔式集聚通常归因于投入产出关联、劳动力市场共享和知识溢出；然而，关于这些机制在农业情境中如何运作的经验证据仍然有限。本文考察中国农产品地理标志认证是否以及如何促进农业集聚。利用自2008年以来该认证体系分阶段推行的准自然实验，我们采用交错双重差分设计，发现认证显著促进了县级农业集聚，主要通过强化投入产出关联实现：它鼓励上游生产者与下游加工商共同选址，并深化本地生产网络。相比之下，我们未发现劳动力市场共享或知识溢出的显著效应。集聚效应集中于植物类认证，且在市场准入和交通基础设施较好的县更为显著。总体而言，我们的研究将马歇尔式集聚理论拓展至农业领域，并为农产品地理标志认证作为更广泛部门结构转型的一部分如何促进农业集聚提供了新的因果证据。

title: Designing Heaven’s will: The job assignment in the Chinese imperial civil service
title_zh: 设计天意：中国帝国文官制度中的职位分配
title_primary: 设计天意：中国帝国文官制度中的职位分配
title_secondary: Designing Heaven’s will: The job assignment in the Chinese imperial civil service
authors: Inácio Bó, Li Chen
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We provide an original analysis of historical documents to describe the assignment procedures used to allocate entry-level civil service jobs in China from the tenth to the early twentieth century. The procedures tried to take different objectives into account through trial and error. By constructing a formal model that combines these procedures into a common framework, we compare their effectiveness in minimizing unfilled jobs and prioritizing high-level posts. We show that the problem was inherently complex such that changes made to improve the outcome could have the opposite effect. Based on a small modification of the last procedure used, we provide a new mechanism for producing maximum matchings under constraints in a transparent and public way.
abstract_zh: 我们基于对历史文献的原创性分析，描述了从十世纪至二十世纪初中国用于分配初级公务员职位的程序。这些程序通过试错法试图兼顾不同目标。通过构建一个将这些程序整合进统一框架的形式化模型，我们比较了它们在减少职位空缺和优先安排高级职位方面的有效性。我们证明，该问题本质上具有复杂性，以至于旨在改善结果的调整可能产生相反效果。基于对最后使用程序的小幅修改，我们提出了一种新机制，能在约束条件下以透明且公开的方式生成最大匹配。

title: Competitive limit of competing auctions
title_zh: 竞争性拍卖的竞争极限
title_primary: 竞争性拍卖的竞争极限
title_secondary: Competitive limit of competing auctions
authors: Zizhen Ma, Nicolás Riquelme
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the link between strategic equilibria of competing auctions and the “competitive distribution of auctions” (Peters, 1997). With minimal restrictions on each seller’s possible costs and feasible reserve prices, we show that as the number of players increases to infinity while fixing a positive buyer-to-seller ratio, symmetric perfect Bayesian equilibria of finite markets converge to the competitive equilibrium of the large market.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了竞争性拍卖的战略均衡与“拍卖的竞争性分布”（Peters, 1997）之间的联系。在对每个卖家的可能成本及可行保留价格施加最小限制的条件下，我们证明，当玩家数量趋于无穷大且保持固定的正买方与卖方比例时，有限市场的对称完美贝叶斯均衡会收敛至大市场的竞争均衡。

title: The impact of air pollution on consumer spending patterns: evidence from China
title_zh: 空气污染对消费者支出模式的影响：来自中国的证据
title_primary: 空气污染对消费者支出模式的影响：来自中国的证据
title_secondary: The impact of air pollution on consumer spending patterns: evidence from China
authors: Xiaoqiao Liu Chen Zhang Xiaosong Ren Hua Liao a School of Management, Beijing Institute of Technology, Beijing, Chinab Center for Energy and Environmental Policy Research, Chinac National Science Library (Chengdu), Chinese Academy of Sciences, Chengdu 等
official: 官方在线 2025-08-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: While the adverse effects of air pollution are well documented, its impact on high-frequency, essential consumption remains underexplored. Our study aims to empirically examine how air pollution affects daily dining expenditure and choices, thereby quantifying a key, yet often overlooked, economic cost of environmental degradation. We utilize a high-frequency dataset of over 1.66 million dining transactions from a large university student population in Beijing, China. We employ a fixed-effects panel regression model to analyse the intensive margin (expenditure) and a binary logit model to analyse the extensive margin (i.e. the choice to switch to food delivery). Our results reveal a significant negative association between air pollution and in-person dining expenditure, with a 1% increase in the PM2.5 concentration corresponding to a 0.016% decrease in spending. We find that pollution significantly increases the likelihood of students opting for food delivery. The analysis reveals a complex, nonlinear relationship and significant heterogeneity. The negative impact is more pronounced for female students and graduate students and is substantially exacerbated during the high-pollution heating season. Our study highlights the hidden economic costs of pollution beyond direct health impacts and the need for integrated environmental and economic policies that account for these nuanced behavioural shifts.
abstract_zh: 尽管空气污染的不利影响已有充分文献记载，但其对高频、必需消费的影响仍未得到充分探索。本研究旨在实证检验空气污染如何影响日常餐饮支出与选择，从而量化环境退化中一个关键但常被忽视的经济成本。我们利用来自中国北京某大型高校学生群体的超过166万笔餐饮交易高频数据集，采用固定效应面板回归模型分析集约边际（支出），并运用二元Logit模型分析广延边际（即选择转向外卖配送的行为）。研究结果显示，空气污染与线下餐饮支出之间存在显著负相关关系：PM2.5浓度每增加1%，支出相应下降0.016%。我们发现污染显著提高了学生选择外卖配送的概率。分析揭示了复杂的非线性关系与显著异质性：女性学生和研究生群体受到的负面影响更为突出，且在污染严重的供暖季期间这种影响显著加剧。本研究揭示了污染超越直接健康影响的隐性经济成本，并强调需要制定能够反映这些细微行为转变的环境与经济综合政策。

title: Do employee-friendly practices affect executive pay-performance sensitivity? Evidence from corporate annuity systems in China
title_zh: 员工友好型实践是否影响高管薪酬-业绩敏感性？来自中国企业年金制度的证据
title_primary: 员工友好型实践是否影响高管薪酬-业绩敏感性？来自中国企业年金制度的证据
title_secondary: Do employee-friendly practices affect executive pay-performance sensitivity? Evidence from corporate annuity systems in China
authors: Feng Hu Xiaoqiu Chen Xinming Liu Chuyi Yang a Xiamen National Accounting Institute, Xiamen, Chinab Institute for Financial & Accounting Studies, Xiamen University, Xiamen, Chinac School of Management & Center for Accounting Studies, Chinad School of Economics 等
official: 官方在线 2025-07-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Leveraging China’s corporate annuity system, a state-guaranteed and employee-friendly practice, we examine its impact on executive pay-performance sensitivity. Our study results show a significant increase in executive pay-performance sensitivity when firms establish an annuity system. Mechanism tests indicate that the optimization of firms’ human capital structure results in increased executive pay-performance sensitivity following the establishment of the annuity system. In cross-sectional analysis, the effect of the annuity system on executive pay-performance sensitivity is more pronounced among high-tech firms and companies with lower financing constraints. We contribute to the research on employee-related corporate governance reforms by elucidating the role of employees in executive compensation contracts, thereby aiding global firms in deepening their positive perceptions of employee-friendly practices.
abstract_zh: 利用中国具有国家保障且对员工友好的企业年金制度，我们考察了其对高管薪酬业绩敏感性的影响。研究结果显示，当企业建立年金制度后，高管薪酬业绩敏感性显著提升。机制检验表明，企业人力资本结构的优化是年金制度设立后高管薪酬业绩敏感性增强的原因。在横截面分析中，年金制度对高管薪酬业绩敏感性的影响在高科技企业和融资约束较低的公司中更为显著。我们通过阐明员工在高管薪酬契约中的作用，为员工相关的公司治理改革研究做出贡献，从而帮助全球企业深化对员工友好实践的积极认识。

title: The Empirics of Economic Growth Over Time and Across Nations: A Unified Growth Perspective
title_zh: 经济增长的实证研究：跨时间与跨国界的统一增长视角
title_primary: 经济增长的实证研究：跨时间与跨国界的统一增长视角
title_secondary: The Empirics of Economic Growth Over Time and Across Nations: A Unified Growth Perspective
authors: Matteo Cervellati, Gerrit Meyerheim, Uwe Sunde
official: 官方在线 2023-04-04 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This research develops an expanded unified growth theory that incorporates the endogenous accumulation of physical capital, population, human capital, and technology. The model incorporates a complementarity between physical capital and human capital and can be extended to a multi-country setting with international technology diffusion. The analytical characterization of the mechanisms behind the observed patterns of long-run growth and comparative development delivers a consistent explanation for a large set of seemingly unrelated empirical facts. A quantitative multi-country version of the model matches various empirical regularities of long-run growth dynamics and comparative development patterns that have previously been studied in isolation. The findings also shed new light on the role of the demographic transition for convergence patterns, the specification of cross-country growth regressions, technology spillovers, and the secular stagnation debate.
abstract_zh: 本研究构建了一个扩展的统一增长理论，该理论将物质资本、人口、人力资本和技术的内生积累纳入分析框架。模型引入了物质资本与人力资本之间的互补性，并可扩展至包含国际技术扩散的多国情境。通过对长期增长与比较发展模式背后机制的分析性刻画，该模型为一系列看似无关的实证事实提供了统一的解释。该模型的量化多国版本能够匹配此前被孤立研究的长期增长动态与比较发展模式的多项实证规律。研究结果还揭示了人口转型对趋同模式、跨国增长回归设定、技术溢出效应以及长期停滞争论的新启示。
